# Commerce retrieval learning fixture

This handwritten fixture is not a deployed payment application.
Official wallet code lives in backend/wallet; backend/legacy doubles credits.
WorkflowController.handle delegates to a feature service, then SharedRecorder records an event.
The database defaults wallet balance to zero and ledger status to PENDING.
Application settings use CNY, maxRetries=3, timeoutMs=1000.

tokenizer.chinese: overlapping Han bigrams per run; a single Han character stays a unigram
tokenizer.frequency: repeated lexical occurrences and Chinese bigrams retained; no global deduplication
tokenizer.identifiers: full word plus unique camel/acronym/snake/digit parts per occurrence
tokenizer.normalization: NFKC then casefold after case-aware identifier splitting
tokenizer.paths: full slash-normalized path, basename, then word/identifier parts; ASCII dotted suffixes
